<Subject 1> = a retired watchmaker in his seventies, small and exact, with wind-blown warm caramel hair down to the collar, magnifying loupe marks around one eye and ink-stained fingertips, wearing a corduroy blazer with elbow patches

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Vintage film, 1960s Kodachrome home movie: saturated reds and deep blues, crisp grain, bright daylight, and the gentle gate weave and flicker of a small-gauge reel. In terraced rice paddies filled with water, each terrace holding a strip of sky, <Subject 1> runs, stumbles, catches themselves and keeps running. The camera pans left with small amplitude at slow speed.

overall_soundscape: Frogs, trickling water between terraces, a distant rooster. Fast footsteps and heavy breathing.

non_diegetic_music: A light ukulele strum at a moderate tempo with brushed percussion.

takes.text:
<Subject 1> = an aristocratic recluse in his seventies, tall and bloodless, with silver-white hair pinned in Victorian coils, a signet ring worn thin and a silver-topped cane he does not need, wearing a high-necked black lace blouse under a velvet frock coat

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, shot on bleach-bypass film: colour drained almost to silver, dense inky shadows, hard metallic sheen on wet skin and steel, and fine grain crawling across the frame. In a flooded forest where the trunks stand in still black water, <Subject 1> turns slowly and looks straight into the camera as the wind lifts their hair. The camera tracks the moving subject at fast speed.

overall_soundscape: Drips, a paddle dipping and distant howler monkeys. Wind and a single breath.

non_diegetic_music: Low sustained strings over a slow, heavy drum pulse that builds and cuts off abruptly.
